description: This file defines classes related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator strategies and a templated stream text handler with support for different terminator sequences. It includes classes for null, carriage return, and line feed terminators, as well as a complex template class for handling text streams with customizable terminators, managing data transmission, reception, and state changes.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for managing text streams with customizable terminators, including data sending, receiving, and state management.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Determines if a character indicates termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the terminator sequence as a string.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data from the internal queue, handling terminator markers.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data, detects terminator sequences, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts raw data bytes to characters.
